# PQ ADBC Advisor — Impact & Adoption

Live telemetry from workspaces running `pq-adbc-advisor` against the ADBC connector migration. Every scan sends anonymous counts (no M code, no item names, no credentials). This board tracks:

- **Reach** — unique workspaces, scans, tenants
- **Resolution** — pins / risk artifacts cleaned up since baseline
- **Health** — send success + coverage + skip reasons

Current version: v0.3.5. Source: https://github.com/MichaelaIsaacs/pq-adbc-advisor

## Distribution reach (GitHub)

Daily rollup emitted by `.github/workflows/github-traffic-to-ai.yml` — GitHub Traffic API clones/views (14d rolling) + release downloads (cumulative). Repo-level, not per-user.

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'github_traffic' and timestamp {TimeRange}
| top 1 by timestamp desc
| project 
    Clones_14d = toint(customDimensions.clones_14d),
    Unique_cloners_14d = toint(customDimensions.unique_cloners_14d),
    Views_14d = toint(customDimensions.views_14d),
    Unique_viewers_14d = toint(customDimensions.unique_viewers_14d),
    Total_release_downloads = toint(customDimensions.total_release_downloads),
    Stargazers = toint(customDimensions.stargazers)
content.title: Latest GitHub distribution snapshot

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'github_traffic' and timestamp {TimeRange}
| project timestamp, 
    clones = toint(customDimensions.clones_14d),
    unique_cloners = toint(customDimensions.unique_cloners_14d),
    views = toint(customDimensions.views_14d),
    unique_viewers = toint(customDimensions.unique_viewers_14d)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Clones and views over time (14-day rolling)

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'github_traffic' and timestamp {TimeRange}
| top 1 by timestamp desc
| project cds = customDimensions
| mv-expand cd = bag_keys(cds)
| where tostring(cd) startswith 'release_downloads_'
| extend Release = replace_string(tostring(cd), 'release_downloads_', '')
| extend Downloads = toint(cds[tostring(cd)])
| order by Release desc
content.title: Release downloads by version (latest snapshot)

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'github_traffic' and timestamp {TimeRange}
| top 1 by timestamp desc
| project 
    top_1 = tostring(customDimensions.top_referrer_1), top_1_count = toint(customDimensions.top_referrer_1_count),
    top_2 = tostring(customDimensions.top_referrer_2), top_2_count = toint(customDimensions.top_referrer_2_count),
    top_3 = tostring(customDimensions.top_referrer_3), top_3_count = toint(customDimensions.top_referrer_3_count)
content.title: Top traffic referrers (latest)

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'scan_complete'
| summarize 
    Users = dcountif(tostring(customDimensions.user_hash), tostring(customDimensions.user_hash) != ''),
    Scans = count(),
    Workspaces = dcount(tostring(customDimensions.workspace_id)),
    Tenants = dcount(tostring(customDimensions.tenant_hash)),
    Versions = dcount(tostring(customDimensions.version))

customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'scan_complete'
| summarize Scans = count(), Workspaces = dcount(tostring(customDimensions.workspace_id)) by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Scans and unique workspaces per day

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'scan_complete'
| summarize Scans=count(), Workspaces=dcount(tostring(customDimensions.workspace_id)), Tenants=dcount(tostring(customDimensions.tenant_hash)) by Version=tostring(customDimensions.version)
| order by Scans desc
content.title: Adoption by version

content.json:
## Resolution — the migration progress story

Every return-run carries both the baseline (`first_*`) and current (`current_*`) counters, plus pre-computed deltas (`resolved_*`, v0.3.5+). Positive delta = the tool showed a problem and someone fixed it. Negative delta = workspace grew after baseline.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'scan_complete' and tostring(customDimensions.is_first_run) == 'False'
| summarize 
    ODBC_pins_resolved = sum(toint(customDimensions.resolved_pinned_odbc)),
    High_risk_resolved = sum(toint(customDimensions.resolved_risk_high)),
    Medium_risk_resolved = sum(toint(customDimensions.resolved_risk_medium)),
    Impacted_artifacts_resolved = sum(toint(customDimensions.resolved_migrating_artifacts))
content.title: Total resolved since baseline (all workspaces, this window)

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'scan_complete' and tostring(customDimensions.is_first_run) == 'False'
| extend delta = toint(customDimensions.resolved_pinned_odbc)
| summarize Cleaned_up = sum(delta) by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: ODBC pins resolved per day

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'scan_complete' and tostring(customDimensions.is_first_run) == 'False'
| project cds = customDimensions
| mv-expand cd = bag_keys(cds)
| where tostring(cd) startswith 'resolved_by_connector_'
| extend Connector = replace_string(tostring(cd), 'resolved_by_connector_', '')
| extend Delta = toint(cds[tostring(cd)])
| summarize Resolved = sum(Delta) by Connector
| where Resolved != 0
| order by Resolved desc
content.title: Resolution by connector

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'scan_complete' and tostring(customDimensions.is_first_run) == 'False'
| project timestamp, 
    workspace = tostring(customDimensions.workspace_id),
    tenant = tostring(customDimensions.tenant_hash),
    baseline_high = toint(customDimensions.first_risk_high),
    current_high = toint(customDimensions.current_risk_high),
    resolved_high = toint(customDimensions.resolved_risk_high),
    baseline_pinned = toint(customDimensions.first_pinned_odbc),
    current_pinned = toint(customDimensions.current_pinned_odbc),
    resolved_pinned = toint(customDimensions.resolved_pinned_odbc),
    days_since_first = toreal(customDimensions.time_since_first_scan_days),
    run_count = toint(customDimensions.run_count),
    version = tostring(customDimensions.version)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by workspace
| order by resolved_pinned desc
content.title: Per-workspace progress (latest return scan)

content.json:
## Value narrative

`estimated_manual_hours_saved = inspected_artifacts × 3 min / 60`. v0.3.5+ credits inspected items only (previously counted skipped items too — a 100x overclaim on gated workspaces).

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'scan_complete'
| summarize 
    Manual_hours_saved = sum(toreal(customDimensions.estimated_manual_hours_saved)),
    Artifacts_inspected = sum(toint(customDimensions.inspected_artifacts)),
    Median_coverage_pct = percentile(toint(customDimensions.coverage_score_pct), 50),
    Sempy_hit_rate = 100.0 * countif(tostring(customDimensions.sempy_used) == 'True') / count()
content.title: Aggregate value + performance signals

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'scan_complete'
| summarize Hours = sum(toreal(customDimensions.estimated_manual_hours_saved)) by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Manual hours saved per day

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'scan_complete'
| project cds = customDimensions
| mv-expand cd = bag_keys(cds)
| where tostring(cd) startswith 'skipped_by_reason_'
| extend reason = replace_string(tostring(cd), 'skipped_by_reason_', '')
| extend n = toint(cds[tostring(cd)])
| summarize count = sum(n) by reason
| order by count desc
content.title: Skip reasons (why we couldn't fully cover a workspace)

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'scan_complete'
| summarize Scans = count() by StateBackend = tostring(customDimensions.state_backend)
| order by Scans desc
content.title: State backend — how many scans have durable baselines

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'scan_complete'
| extend duration = toreal(customDimensions.duration_seconds)
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p90 = percentile(duration, 90), p99 = percentile(duration, 99) by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Scan duration (p50 / p90 / p99, seconds)

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'validation_complete'
| summarize 
    Validated = sum(toint(customDimensions.validated_count)),
    Passed = sum(toint(customDimensions.passed)),
    Passed_with_regression = sum(toint(customDimensions.passed_with_regression)),
    Failed = sum(toint(customDimensions.failed))
content.title: Validation outcomes

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'scan_complete'
| summarize scans = count() by version = tostring(customDimensions.version), first_run = tostring(customDimensions.is_first_run)
| order by version asc
content.title: First-run vs return-run split (proves users iterate, not just kick tires)

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'scan_complete' and tostring(customDimensions.is_first_run) == 'False'
| extend days = toreal(customDimensions.time_since_first_scan_days)
| where days > 0
| summarize p50 = percentile(days, 50), p90 = percentile(days, 90), median_days = percentile(days, 50)
| project P50_days_to_return = p50, P90_days_to_return = p90
content.title: Time from first scan → return scan (proves iterative use)
